fullContent:
Kamchudamani Ras 
 Reference: Siddha Bheshaja Manimala 
 Introduction 
 Kamchudamani Ras is a classical preparation containing herbs and mineral in tablet form. This Ayurvedic medicine useful as aphrodisiac therapy and relieve Premature Ejaculation. 
 Ingredients and Method of Preparation 
 
 Mauktika Bhasma (Pearl Bhasma) 
 Hemamakshika Bhasma (Bhasma of Copper pyrite) 
 Swarna Bhasma (Gold Bhasma) 
 Vanga (Tin Bhasma) 
 Rajata Bhasma (Silver Bhasma) 
 Japatri, Jatiphala ( Myritica fragrans ) – Leaves and fruits of Nutmeg 
 Lavanga (Clove) ( Syzigium aromaticum ) 
 Twak (Cinnamon) ( Cinnamomum zeylanicum ) 
 Patra ( Cinnamomum tamala ) 
 Ela (Cardamom) ( Elettaria cardamomum ) 
 Nagakeshara ( Mesua ferrea ) 
 
 Dose 
 Consume 1-2 tablets 1-2 times daily before or after having meals along with milk or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This ayurvedic medicine is useful as natural aphrodisiac. 
 It can even treat Premature Ejaculation and Erectile dysfunction. 
 Also reduces swelling and solve the Urinary problems and Indigestion 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine must be consumed under strict directions only. 
 Its self-medication might be unsafe. 
 It is better to avoid in children and pregnant ladies. 
 It’s over dose might results in side effects like tremors, dizziness etc. 
 Have this medicine under recommended dose and specified period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
